verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no feature for creating or running autonomous background automations, scheduled jobs, or agentic workflows in RustDesk. Unattended access with a permanent password is an adjacent remote-access capability, not automation. The Server Pro management API is only a developer building block, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
